name: Document360
description: Document360 MCP helps authorized users search their knowledge base content, inspect project versions and category trees, create and update articles or categories, publish or unpublish content, and move documents through workflow assignments.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Document360 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Document360 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.document360.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Document360 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Document360 lists 17 MCP tools, including document360-mcp-create-article, document360-mcp-create-category, document360-mcp-get-article, document360-mcp-get-categories, document360-mcp-get-category, document360-mcp-get-project-versions, document360-mcp-get-workflow-assignees, document360-mcp-get-workflow-statuses, document360-mcp-publish-article, document360-mcp-publish-category, document360-mcp-search, and document360-mcp-set-workflow-status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Document360?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Document360 in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Document360 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Document360 is developed by Document360. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
